{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, verify that all revenue entries with commas are in the expected format
print("Sample of revenue with commas:", data['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sample(5).values)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:", data['revenue_clean'].head())

# Now, check for the QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check if any of the QA orders are marked as 'completed'
print("QA orders that are completed:", (qa_orders['status'] == 'completed').sum())"}
